parts.answer: The correctly shaded intersection of the closed disc with centre $-2+3i$ and radius $2$ and the region satisfying $\arg z\leq\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Show a circle with centre $-2+3i$. B1. Guidance: must see $(-2,3)$ or appropriate marks on axes. Show a circle of radius $2$ and centre not at the origin. B1. Show the correct half-line from the origin. B1. Guidance: $\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$ or $\dfrac\pi4$ seen, or a half-line approximately bisecting the angle $\dfrac\pi2$. Shade the correct region. B1. Guidance: maximum 3 out of 4 if any errors are seen. Total 4.
